title: Operation only works on directories.
summary: A subclass of OSError, Exception, BaseException.

title: Method or function hasn't been implemented yet.
summary: A subclass of RuntimeError, Exception, BaseException.

title: Check that function does not return Any value.
summary: If you use --warn-return-any, mypy generates an error if you return a value with a plain Any type in a function that is annotated to return a non-Any value. You can use this to enforce better boundaries around unsafe/dynamic code. mypy does not enable this error code by default. Use --enable-error-code no-any-return to enable it.

title: Check that types have no Any components due to missing imports.
summary: If you use --disallow-any-unimported, mypy generates an error if a component of a type becomes Any because mypy couldn't resolve an import. These "stealth" Any types can be surprising and accidentally cause imprecise type checking. mypy does not enable this error code by default. Use --enable-error-code no-any-unimported to enable it.

title: Check that overloaded functions have an implementation.
summary: Overloaded functions outside of stub files must be followed by a non overloaded implementation. mypy enables this error code by default.

title: Check that each name is defined once.
summary: Mypy may generate an error if you have multiple definitions for a name in the same namespace. The reason is that this is often an error, as the second definition may overwrite the first one. mypy enables this error code by default.

title: Check that no untyped functions are called.
summary: If you use --disallow-untyped-calls, mypy generates an error when you call an unannotated function in an annotated function. mypy does not enable this error code by default. Use --enable-error-code no-untyped-call to enable it.

title: Check that every function has an annotation.
summary: If you use --disallow-untyped-defs, mypy requires that all functions have annotations (either a Python 3 annotation or a type comment). mypy does not enable this error code by default. Use --enable-error-code no-untyped-def to enable it.

title: Check that NoneType is not used as a type (annotation).
summary: The preferred way to annotate the type of None is None. NoneType is equivalent, but mypy won't allow it by default. mypy enables this error code by default.
